episodes.title: Vatican & World News 24.10.2026
episodes.description: - The Pope praises one group’s efforts to engage young people in the life of the Church by helping them discover Christ’s love. - The Vatican is preparing a new aid mission to Ukraine. - The regional crisis coordinator for the Gaza response with the UN migration agency describes the challenges facing families in the enclave as winter approaches.

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 22.10.2026
episodes.description: - Pope Leo urges young people to register for World Youth Day 2027, taking place next year in Seoul - The Dicastery for the Doctrine of the Faith reflects on transmitting the faith in an age of epochal change - Cardinal Pietro Parolin invites the faithful to seek peace through the intercession of Pope St John Paul II

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 21.10.2026
episodes.description: - Pope Leo highlights the importance of family as the foundation of society during the weekly General Audience - Christian leaders in the Holy Land denounce an attack on the Christian community of Taybeh in the West Bank - The Holy See calls for the dignity and culture of indigenous peoples to be respected

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 20.10.2026
episodes.description: - The Permanent Observer of the Holy See to the UN insists on the need to eliminate nuclear weapons in order to promote peace and international security. - The Church in France is calling for a response to the anxiety expressed by young people and those who feel marginalized or left behind. - Abu Dhabi hosts an event to mark the 800th anniversary of the death of St. Francis, led by the Apostolic Vicariate of Southern Arabia.

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 17.10.2026
episodes.description: - Pope Leo returns to the Vatican four day after surgery at Rome's Gemerlli Hospital to remove a nodule on his lung - Catholics pray the Rosary for the Church’s global mission on the eve of World Mission Day - Donald Trump suspends some sanctions against Russia as deadly attacks plunge Ukraine into darkness

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 15.10.2026
episodes.description: - Pope Leo continues to recover in hospital after doctors successfully removed a tumor from his right lung. - During the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly in New York, the Permanent Observer of the Holy See to the UN addresses the need for disarmament to build peace. - A school in Kazakhstan is nurturing intercultural understanding, interreligious dialogue and technological skills, offering young people the confidence to shape their own future.

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 13.10.2026
episodes.description: - Pope Leo is admitted to Rome’s Gemelli hospital for surgery to remove a nodule in his lung - Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says Russian forces have struck at least six energy facilities across the country, raising doubts about a floated energy ceasefire - The US military archbishop appeals to Catholic soldiers not to take part in the upcoming firing squad for the execution of Nidal Hassan

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 12.10.2026
episodes.description: - Pope Leo will be admitted to Rome’s Gemelli hospital on Tuesday, where he’ll undergo surgery to remove a small nodule from his lung - Cardinal Gerald Lacroix says the Church needs to be present to families and go out to meet them where they are - In Geneva, Archbishop Paul Richard Gallagher says migrant and refugee children must be welcomed, not merely assisted

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 10.10.2026
episodes.description: - Pope Leo reaffirms the Catholic Church’s rejection of the death penalty with a post on his official X account. - The President of the International Committee of the Red Cross calls for international law to be restored in conflict zones. - On World Porridge Day, the story of a young Malawian woman whose life was transformed by a daily school meal offers a reflection on the importance of school feeding programs in the fight against hunger.

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 08.10.2026
episodes.description: - Pope Leo convenes Bishops from around the world to reflect on ten years of Amoris Laetitia - At the UN, the Holy See renews its call for an international moratorium on the use of the death penalty - The Church in Papua New Guinea appeals for prayers for rain amid a prolonged drought

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 06.10.2026
episodes.description: - Pope Leo says marital love is a lifetime “Yes” in the forward of a new edition of the Youth Catechism - Two World Food Programme trucks are attacked in Sudan as fighting in the nation continues - UNICEF calls on governments to prepare for El Nino weather phenomena that threaten millions of children

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 05.10.2026
episodes.description: - The Pope sends a message to the parish priest of Gaza’s Catholic Church after an Israeli strike - Pope Leo emphasizes the need to recognize and appreciate women who work in the Vatican - As the Season of Creation comes to an end, Pacific nations urge world leaders to act for the climate

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 02.10.2026
episodes.description: - Bishops in the US State of Tennessee call on its governor to commute Christa Pike’s death sentence after a failed execution attempt - Cardinal Matteo Zuppi returns to Rome following his third peace mission to Moscow - Pope Leo says that in “the age of search engines" the Church needs artists to aid pastors in making the Gospel “accessible and understandable"

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 30.09.2026
episodes.description: - Pope Leo reflects on his recently concluded Apostolic Journey to France during his General audience - In an appeal at the conclusion of the General Audience, the Holy Father calls for dialogue amid renewed violence in Tigray - Archbishop Paul Richard Gallagher highlights the role religions can plan in the search for peace

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 29.09.2026
episodes.description: - Look back at the Pope’s Apostolic Journey through his own words on the flight back to Rome. - The Church in Vietnam is helping integrate the hundreds of people migrating in search of work and education. - The Dicastery for Communication releases the theme for the 2027 World Communications Day.

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 28.09.2026
episodes.description: - Pope Leo’s celebrates Holy Mass in the French border city of Metz at the conclusion of his four-day apostolic visit to France - He addresses a gathering of European religious leaders at the Robert Schumann Conference Centre and upholds Europe’s Christian roots

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 26.09.2026
episodes.description: - Pope Leo’s second day in France sees him visit a House for migrants in Paris, address the French Church, celebrate Holy Mass in the presence of 800,000 people - And he says "adieu" to Paris as he flies to Lourdes for the second leg of his apostolic journey

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 24.09.2026
episodes.description: - On the eve of Pope Leo XIV’s apostolic journey to France and his visit to UNESCO headquarters in Paris, we shine a light on some of the issues he is expected to address - The Pope reiterates his call to accompany scientific and technological progress with a corresponding growth in responsibility - In the run-up to the beatification of Archbishop Fulton Sheen in the United States, we look back to his life and enduring legacy

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 23.09.2026
episodes.description: - Ahead of the World Day of Migrants and Refugees Pope Leo XIV appeals for the protection and care of minors on the move - The Apostolic Nuncio to France speaks about ongoing preparations and expectations for the Pope’s imminent visit to the country - At the General Audience, the Pope reflects on how humanity can develop its potential and work to build a better future with the help of God

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 22.09.2026
episodes.description: - UNESCO’s Deputy Director-General reflects on the significance of the Pope Leo’s visit to France. - A South Sudanese bishop calls on the people of the country to renew their commitment to peace, reconciliation, and justice. - United Nations agencies’ latest alert reveals a difficult situation in Haiti, where more than 250,000 children aged 6 to 59 months are expected to suffer from acute malnutrition.

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 19.09.2026
episodes.description: - Pope Leo reflects on the ministry of bishops in a letter to the bishops of Latin America and the Caribbean - With the war against Ukraine still ongoing, Russians head to the polls for parliamentary elections - The Church continues to prepare for the next World Youth Day, which will be held in Seoul, South Korea, in 2027

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 18.09.2026
episodes.description: - A short documentary made in collaboration with the Vatican begins its journey to the Oscars - The new Holy See Observer tells the United Nations that hate speech erodes the conditions in which freedom of expression can flourish. - A week ahead of the Pope’s apostolic journey to France, the Vatican releases more details about the visit

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 17.09.2026
episodes.description: - Ahead of Pope Leo XIV’s Apostolic Journey to Uruguay in early November, the country’s Bishops make their ad limina Apostolorum visit this week. - Cardinal Pietro Parolin states he is ‘concerned’ over states ‘going it alone’ on artificial intelligence. - A UK Catholic charity trustee reflects on how Catholics’ generosity can be better connected to the Church’s mission and teaching.

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 16.09.2026
episodes.description: - Three Vatican dicasteries release a joint note marking the 60th anniversary of the declaration Nostra aetate - A conference in the Vatican asks whether the 21st century is a ‘New Age of Martyrs’ - At the General Audience, Pope Leo says that our growing interdependence must find its fulfilment in a deeper spiritual communion between persons

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 12.09.2026
episodes.description: - Residents of the last Christian village in the West Bank have launched a civil case against the Israeli settlers - Pope Leo stresses shared responsibility in the face of social, economic and technological challenges - The World Catholic Association for Communication awards its Film Prize to a Japanese film about friendship

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 11.09.2026
episodes.description: - 25 years after the September 11 terrorist attacks on the Twin Towers, the Archbishop of New York speaks about the impact of the tragedy - The UK Parliament votes against proposed assisted dying legislation, which the Bishops of England and Wales had warned was “dangerous and flawed” - We speak to Jack Matika, a member of Kenya’s Koinonia Association, which helps young people sleeping rough on the streets of Nairobi

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 10.09.2026
episodes.description: - Pope Leo XVI invites new bishops to keep their hearts open to everyone amid rapid global change - A North-South socio-environmental dialogue promoted by the Pontifical Commission for Latin America offers a multilateral response to the major transformations occurring in the Americas - On the eve of the 25th anniversary of the 11 September attacks on New York’s World Trade Centre, the New York Fire Department Chief of Operations at the time honours those who lost their lives with an initiative to “Give Back”

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 09.09.2026
episodes.description: - In his General Audience, Pope Leo stresses that the dignity of every human person is a permanent gift of God’s love that we must defend. - A summit on “Artificial Intelligence and Human Sense”, held in Bali as part of the 11th International Congress of Scholas Chairs concludes. - The President of the French Bishops’ Conference, along with other bishops, present details of the Pope’s upcoming apostolic journey to France.

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 08.09.2026
episodes.description: - Pope Leo XIV urges young people in Africa to live as a message of love, justice, and peace to the world - Catholic aid organizations continue to assist the Ukrainian people facing daily attacks from Russian air strikes - Middle Eastern religious leaders gather in Rome for talks dedicated to peacebuilding and interreligious dialogue

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 07.09.2026
episodes.description: - Pope Leo renewed his appeal for peace in Ukraine during his Angelus as new peace talks begin with the US, Ukraine, and Russia. - Cardinal Pizzaballa launches a new initiative to explore Jerusalem’s universal vocation for peace and reconciliation. - Pope Leo returns to the Shrine of the Mother of Good Counsel in Genazzano to celebrate the vigil Mass for the Feast of the Nativity of the Blessed Virgin Mary.

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 04.09.2026
episodes.description: - Pope Leo points to St. John Henry Newman as an example of the inseparability of faith and reason - Almost a month after the earthquake, the Church in Colombia continues to help those affected - Bishops from Mexico, Canada and the United States come together in Mexico to reflect on their different realities

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 02.09.2026
episodes.description: - The International Theological Commission issues a document noting that the way we care for Creation reveals and shapes our relationship with God - The Holy See renews its appeal to end nuclear testing and strive towards a nuclear-free world - In a time marked by tensions, conflicts and change, Pope Leo XIV begins a new series of catecheses focused on Vatican Two documents dedicated to the Church in the modern world

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 01.09.2026
episodes.description: - For the month of September, Pope Leo invites everyone to defend and pray for equal access to water, as Christians celebrate the Season of Creation. - A Canadian Bishop of the Military Ordinariate speaks about the new instructions barring chaplains from offering faith-specific prayers at certain events. - September 1 marks the annual World Day of Prayer for the Care of Creation and the beginning of the Season of Creation.

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 31.08.2026
episodes.description: - Search and rescue operations in Nepal continue, with more than 4000 people still missing after last week’s deadly floods - The United States and Iran trade strikes as fighting in the Middle East escalates once again - The Church prepares to celebrate the Season of Creation beginning on Tuesday with the Day of Prayer for the Care of Creation

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 29.08.2026
episodes.description: - In a new motu proprio, Pope Leo grants Eastern Synods the faculty to remove Patriarchs when communion is impaired - The Dicastery for the Service of Charity provides aid to relief operations in Nepal after deadly flooding - Pope Leo is set to take part in traditional Marian procession at Castel Gandolfo

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 28.08.2026
episodes.description: - Pope Leo meets with a delegation from the St. Vincent de Paul Society of the United States of America. - The Executive Director of Caritas Nepal shares how the Church's local humanitarian organization is supporting those displaced by the devastating flash floods that struck the north of the country. - The Holy See Secretary for Relations with States and International Organisations finishes his weeklong visit to Russia.

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 27.08.2026
episodes.description: - Pope Leo prays for the victims of the devastating Nepal floods. - A climate scientist reflects on the disaster in Nepal. - The Latin Patriarch of Jerusalem calls for more diplomacy to stop the violence in the Middle East.

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 26.08.2026
episodes.description: - The Vatican’s foreign minister meets with his Russian counterpart in Moscow, for the first in person talks between the two states in five years - Hundreds are feared dead following flash flooding in Nepal - In a meeting with Norway’s Lutheran bishops, Pope Leo urges Christians to work together to promote peace and justice in our turbulent times.

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 25.08.2026
episodes.description: - Pope Leo urges participants in Italy’s National Liturgical Week to put the liturgy at the centre of Christian formation - This year’s Season of Creation will be inaugurated with a Mass for the Care of Creation celebrated by the Holy Father - The Office of Papal Charities is supporting efforts to feed Ukrainians affected by the ongoing war

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 22.08.2026
episodes.description: - Pope Leo XIV begins his pastoral visit to the fifth smallest country in the world, San Marino. - Our correspondent on the ground in the Italian city of Rimini, Francesca Merlo, speaks with the Prior General of the Augustinians. - The Pope encourages participants in the Rimini Meeting to learn from Jesus' example of promoting peace in times of conflict and injustice.

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 21.08.2026
episodes.description: - Pope Leo addresses the International Catholic Legislators Network, urging them to protect human rights and human dignity. - The first day of the 47th edition of the Meeting for Friendship Among Peoples opens in the Italian city of Rimini. - 80 priests in Colombia offer ‘spiritual first aid’ to families impacted by the earthquake which hit the country earlier this week.

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 19.08.2026
episodes.description: - Pope Leo expresses his condolences for the Polish pilgrims involved in a bus accident in Hungary - Colombia continues facing a humanitarian emergency after the August 10 earthquake - Pope Leo reflects on the importance of sacred music during the Wednesday General Audience

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 18.08.2026
episodes.description: - Pope Leo mourns victims of a ferry disaster in Zimbabwe, which claimed the lives of more than 80 people. - In a Mass dedicated to St. Agatha, Cardinal Parolin invites everyone to pray for the many Christians persecuted around the world. - The Pope's garden next to the Mater Ecclesiae monastery in the Vatican Gardens is now 100% organic.

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 14.08.2026
episodes.description: - In a message for the upcoming World Day of Migrants and Refugees, Pope Leo focuses on the suffering of migrant children - Mass is once again being celebrated in a monastery in war-torn southern Lebanon - Church leaders are meeting in Peru to develop proposals to respond to the challenges facing the country

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 12.08.2026
episodes.description: - Pope Leo sends a cheque to the dioceses in Colombia struck by a deadly 7.4 magnitude earthquake on Monday - The Holy See Press Office releases the schedule for the Pope’s upcoimg visit to the Republic of San Marino and the Italian city of Rimini - At the General Audience, Pope Leo reflects on the liturgical year, describing Sunday as its “foundation and kernel” and urging Catholics to actively participate in the Eucharist

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 10.08.2026
episodes.description: - Aid groups warn of dire consequences for civilians as Sudan’s army opens new offensives against the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces - The UN Secretary-General condemns attacks on civilian areas in both Russia and Ukraine - Cardinal Pierbattista Pizzaballa, the Latin Patriarch of Jerusalem, joins a group of young people from across the Mediterranean for five days of encounter, prayer and reflection dedicated to peace

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 08.08.2026
episodes.description: - Pope Leo will travel to the Shrine of Our Lady of Good Counsel in September – repeating the first outing he made as pontiff last year. - The President of the Symposium of Episcopal Conferences of Africa and Madagascar reflects on synodality in the Church in Africa at the the first preparatory seminar for the 2028 Ecclesial Assembly. - Caritas Cuba continues to provide access to food and basic necessities to the most vulnerable during an ongoing economic crisis in the country.

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 06.08.2026
episodes.description: - Pope Leo carries out a pastoral visit to Assisi, telling the thousands of young people gathered there to make courageous lifelong commitments - Cardinal Pizzaballa, the Latin Patriarch of Jerusalem, decries the current situation of “neither war nor peace” in the Holy Land - We speak to President of the Argentine Bishops’ Conference about Pope Leo’s upcoming Apostolic Visit to the country

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 04.08.2026
episodes.description: - Pope Leo urges Catholic communicators to shape a digital culture that serves the truth and defends human dignity - The Catholic Church in Tangier gets to work helping Moroccan migrants returning from the Spanish enclave of Ceuta - An Indonesian Vatican official returns to his native village with relics from Rome, in a quest to turn it into a center for prayer and pilgrimage.

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 03.08.2026
episodes.description: - Pope Leo will meet thousands of young Europeans in Assisi on Thursday to mark the end of a Franciscan gathering centred on peace, forgiveness and vocation. - The organizers of the 2027 World Youth Day in Seoul, South Korea release the event’s official hymn. - Zanzibar gears up to host the 6th edition of the International Kitesurf Race, dedicated to bringing people together from different countries, cultures, and backgrounds.

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 31.07.2026
episodes.description: - Pope Leo releases his prayer intention for August, dedicated to praying "for evangelization in the city." - As the one-year countdown to World Youth Day Seoul 2027 begins on August 3, the Local Organizing Committee shares its progress in preparing the city to welcome young pilgrims from across the world. - The Diocese of Cádiz and Ceuta in Spain steps its response to the migration emergency unfolding, after an unprecedented surge in arrivals from neighbouring Morocco.

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 30.07.2026
episodes.description: - In an interview with an American broadcaster, Pope Leo XIV highlights the importance of immigration in the history of the United States - The Holy See Press Office releases the programme of the Pope’s visit to Assisi on 6 August - Local churches in Spain and France support thousands who have lost their homes in wildfires devastating the European continent

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 28.07.2026
episodes.description: In the headlines this Tuesday the 28th of July: - Around 300,000 people are evacuated or displaced in France and Spain as firefighters continue to battle wildfires raging for at least seven days, - A statue of Our Lady is defaced and an outdoor altar set alight at the Marian shrine of Medjugorje, and - And Pope Leo urges communicators to place every technological tool at the service of truth and the common good.

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 25.07.2026
episodes.description: - Pope Leo XIV encourages the Church in Asia to build bridges throughout the continent - Israel prepares an extensive operation in the West Bank as settlers and the military continue to displace Palestinians - Wildfires in Europe displace almost 270,000 people

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 23.07.2026
episodes.description: - The bishops of Venezuela appeal for post-quake reconstruction that is free from negligence and corruption - Civilians continue to bear the brunt of Israeli attacks in Gaza nine months after the ceasefire - Nearly 650 million people worldwide experienced hunger last year, according to the just-released State of Food Security and Nutrition in the World Report

episodes.title: Vatican & World News 22.07.2026
episodes.description: - Pope Leo XIV thanks Major Superiors of Men in the United States for 70 years of witness to Christ - Over 140 people are dead or missing after the shipwreck of a migrant boat off the coast of Mauritania - The death toll from Venezuela’s twin earthquakes on 24 June continues to rise
